loanMetadata.baseline: confirmed principal at the start of baselineDate; never the entire account balance
loanMetadata.owner: trusted server identity, uid-scoped loan/account FK
loanMetadata.schedule: optional structured plan params; scheduleMethod/scheduleTerms/measurementKind all-or-none; kind=rate needs quoteType+ratePpm, kind=repayment needs repaymentMinor and forbids quote fields; installment quote requires flat method; rate is integer ppm (12.5% = 125000), amounts integer minor units, daily quote uses 360-day year; feeUpfrontMinor < installmentSetup.originalPrincipalMinor for new installments, otherwise < baselinePrincipalMinor when both set; changing params never recalculates an existing plan

installmentSetup.originalPrincipalMinor: positive integer minor string, distinct from current baseline
installmentSetup.historicalPaidTerms: confirmed consecutive paid terms before enrollment, integer 0..scheduleTerms; never inferred from dates
installmentSetup.customRecordType: trimmed string <=12 code points, only for other
installmentSetup.discountValue: null with null kind; positive minor string for cash discounts or ppm ratio <=1000000 for interest discount (7折=700000)

loanMetadata.installmentRules: New page always kind=installment, requires firstPaymentDate, previews remaining schedule and confirms baseline/date. Historical rows never create payments; remaining principal equals sum of later planned principal. Interest discount recomputes using reduced rate; cash discounts reduce fees then interest, never principal. Total discount is allocated across the full original schedule with bounded integer rounding before slicing history. Upfront fees are metadata only, excluded from remaining-plan totals. Legacy nullable setup remains readable.

readResponse.unchanged: knownRevision equals snapshot revision; no business payload; requires matching full local snapshot

rules: Signed preview binds uid, loan/contract/charge/transaction versions, event and dependencies. Adjust net amount, suppress/explicit restore, pause/cancel future or explicitly recognize distinct additional bank fee. No client-only accrued evidence. Paid/refunded/source dependencies block partial maintenance. Audit preserves history.

One-off coverage children also block ordinary adjustment/deletion. Explicit actual refund creates a linked refund with cumulative/date/account guards; future cancellation never creates one. Suppressed charges require explicit restore.
Pause authorization; cancel unoccurred future charges for settled/waiver/contract_cancelled, pause for rate_changed. Never create a refund, payment or principal change.
Pure read; server Asia/Shanghai cutoff, active authorization and liability/category, inclusive start/end. once mode requires explicit contract and confirmation.
Same scope/identity and emergency stop checks as sync; no client-supplied cutoff.

At most 40 due charges under original user lock and one atomic receipt. Server cutoff only; original billing dates; origin=loan_plan and unverified basis. No asset, principal or payment mutation. Pagination retries select remaining charge identities; committed prior batches remain committed. Active account/category/loan required.

Explicit contract scope never includes other auto contracts. Scope ids must belong to trusted user. CATLEDGER_LOAN_SYNC_DISABLED=1 blocks new synchronization; original successful receipts remain replayable.

Pure read; page size 1..40, cursor binds uid/loan/revision/period/configuration digest. Preview classifies existing, covered, outside, future and due; server cutoff. Saved period components precede generated plan. Preview is not authorization; exact transaction coverage revalidated on write.

Items expose amountMinor, refundMinor, netAmountMinor, settledMinor, outstandingMinor (floor zero), state and basis. Summary recorded/unverified are net recorded amounts. Unknown attribution stays a candidate.

Trusted uid and original user lock. Stable (uid,contract_id,charge_key) independent of amount/request/version. Authorization does not write transactions. Historical coverage claims an exact expense on the liability account; one-off actual costs cover enumerated schedule items. Existing recorded/suppressed history cannot be overwritten or resurrected by a revision. Archived no-reference contracts must be explicitly claimed.
Revoke future synchronization, preserve financial records and append authorization audit. Archive also pauses authorization; restore never resumes it.
Trusted uid, consistent snapshot; full original schedule overlaid with saved period revisions. Page size 1..40, signed cursor binds user/loan/version/dataRevision.

Continuous completedThrough is the max of manual progress, active source terms and legacy fully paid periods. Explicit unpaid/partial and legacy partial remain exceptions. Missing bills alone never mean overdue. Differences preserve original bank amounts.
Trusted uid and one valid period. Includes active/inactive sources (latest 40, moreSources flag) and up to 20 existing payment links; no write.
Only active unassigned items in trusted user scope; optional account/item filters bound to signed cursor. Page size 1..40; invalidated events or deleted/changed expense sources do not count.

Progress schema2: one period completed only changes that exception; completedThrough requires confirmedBatch=true and preserves unpaid/partial and outside-range exceptions. Source maximum period never proves payment; legacy ambiguous through is retained for review; explicit historical confirmation and actual payments stay separate.

Progress creates no principal/cash transaction. Legacy bookCosts remains only for unconfigured installments with existing guards; a configured charge contract must use authorized charge commands. All changes, versions and original receipt remain atomic.

Same user/account and compatible term count; selected active source and its exact installment reference / same-transaction source group attach under one user lock; an existing assignment to another active installment rejects. Ambiguous identities/amounts reject atomically. Amount/date similarity never establishes identity.

A first imported fee can reuse a matching manual fee. Different active bank identities for the same cost component must be resolved, never silently combined. Duplicate import expense is soft-replaced with preserved evidence; refund/loan-payment dependencies block replacement.

Archive only an installment management record: detach its source items and release reference bindings atomically with archiving/version/receipt under the trusted user lock. Keep all source identities and financial transactions; valid sources become unassigned and can rebuild or relink without reposting costs. Restore only reopens the management record, never steals sources already reassigned. Expected version and frozen receipt required.

Only a same-user manual cost item with expected loan/item versions. Imported evidence/refund dependencies block removal. Soft-delete its expense and deactivate item atomically; preserve audit and independent progress.
trusted identity and active status, same read-only snapshot
no aggregate queries; coalesced once per foreground

repayment: confirmed=true, mode=defer|associate, assetAccountId, liabilityAccountId (other_liability), explicit principalMinor/interestMinor/feeMinor, expense|accrued treatment and expense category IDs; exact total. associate additionally requires loanId/loanVersion. Financial transactions, confirmed details and optional loan share commit atomically.
associate may include repayment.chargeAllocations to prove recorded fees; deferred unknown attribution cannot use an unsupported accrued claim.
Only active confirmed repayments with no allocations. Confirm stored composition and matching account/baseline; update loan/payment versions without adding transactions.
Release only pending confirmed repayments, preserving all financial transactions. Never silently detach an allocated payment.

returns: allocations (whole-payment shares; first 3 actual periods, periodCount, unallocated components)
evidence (bounded raw hints, never confirmed financial facts)
rules: Trusted uid; consistent read-only snapshot; active linked/replaced relations take priority for every account type. Only explicitly confirmed active repayments without loan allocations return candidate with payment and repayment details. Ordinary transfers to every account type return none. No inferred installment, amount or period; revoked relations are not reported active.

rules: Only confirmed active repayments without loan allocations; whole financial group appears once; returns total and repaymentTotalMinor; cursor binds uid/month/account. Credit bill repayments remain ordinary transfers without a loan-association prompt.

Nonempty unique current-user manual/import transactions without a 100-item cap; the complete selected set is validated and deleted in one user-locked transaction, with bounded SQL chunks; all-or-nothing; versions, loan associations, final cash balance and refunds outside selection validated; archived accounts allowed; selected original and refunds can be removed together; frozen receipt recoverable via transactions.commandResult.
One private job per authenticated user; one hour expiry; start/replay does not change business revision.
Signed keyset/UTF-8 fragment cursor; 50 completed rows and 65536 UTF-8 text bytes maximum; unchanged business revision required.
Only signed terminal token; active user lock checks revision; immutable completed result can be replayed.

loans.periods.returns: {loanId,loanName,loanVersion,summary,items,nextCursor}; page 1..40; optional at most 40 selected IDs, same loan only; signed cursor includes loan version. Summary includes unpaid principal/interest/fee, next due date, remaining principal and explicit gap; never mark paid by date; paidPeriods counts fully paid active plan rows from actual allocations; installment setup adds historicalPaidTerms and totalTerms, displayed separately from actual paid periods.

loans.savePeriod.returns: {loanId,loanVersion,periodId,version}; period number 1..9999 unique per loan, explicit nonnegative components with positive total. Revision preserves original plan; cannot reduce below paid components or cancel paid period; no Transaction writes; installment periodNumber must be within scheduleTerms; historical rows require explicit historicalRevision=true. No cash or progress writes. Changed future charge components pause the affected planned fees; explicit reauthorization adopts saved period amounts without overwriting recorded history.

loans.allocatePeriods.returns: {paymentId,version,loanId,loanVersion,allocatedPeriods}; replace this active repayment's allocations for one loan, 0..40 unique versioned periods with explicit principal/interest/fee. Preserve old rows; each component bounded by payment share and period remainder; unallocated remainder remains explicit

loans.planAllocation.returns: {loanVersion,payment,share,items,unallocated}; max 40 active period allocations for current loan; actual allocated+unallocated components equal repayment share

loans.periodHistory.returns: {periodId,kind,items,nextCursor}; kind=plan|payment; page 1..40, user/period/kind signed cursor; preserve plan revisions and replaced/reversed actual allocation facts

data: loanId? (read stored params and original principal when setup exists, else principal baseline)
loans.previewPlan.returns: {periods:[{periodNumber,dueDate,principalMinor,interestMinor,feeMinor}],summary:{totalPaymentMinor,totalInterestMinor,totalFeeMinor,derivedRatePpm?,remainingPrincipalMinor?,historicalPaidTerms?,totalTerms?,upfrontFeeMinor?}}; new setup slices original N historical terms, preserves original period numbers, omits zero-payment tasks; optional remaining/history fields only with setup.
rules: Read-only trusted user snapshot; supplied setup original principal is authoritative over principalMinor. Legacy date fallback and upfront-inclusive totals remain; new setup requires explicit first date when saved and remaining totals exclude upfront fee. Zero payment months are not persisted. No auto-paid-by-date behavior.

Stored params and original principal (new setup) or positive baseline (legacy) required; existing periods including cancelled reject LOAN_PLAN_EXISTS. Zero remaining periods rejects validation. Under one user lock/transaction insert only unpaid historical suffix, preserving original numbers and version-1 revisions, and advance loan version. No Transaction/payment/balance writes; later maintenance through savePeriod/allocatePeriods. Replay frozen receipt.

data: accountId? (filter before paging; bound to cursor)
loans.list.returns: {items: Loan[], pendingRepaymentCount: number, nextCursor: string|null}; pageSize 1..40; signed user-scoped cursor; pendingRepaymentCount uses the same optional accountId filter; archived records excluded; installmentSummary holds progress-derived remaining amounts without changing ledger principal

loans.create.returns: {loanId,version,generatedPeriods?}; new installmentSetup requires kind=installment and confirmed atomic metadata + remaining periods/revisions + receipt; supplied baseline must equal computed remaining principal. Legacy metadata-only requests stay supported. Metadata/plan creation never creates principal or future-fee transactions. Optional sourceItemId attaches pending bank items in the same transaction; source conflicts roll back the entire creation.; cash_borrowing with explicit origin permits zero initial baseline and records actual drawdown separately.

loans.update.returns: {loanId,version}; omitted installmentSetup preserves stored setup. Existing new-style periods lock original principal, history, discounts, schedule fields and baseline. Name/classification may change. Never regenerates plans; generatePlan is rejected here.

loans.record.returns: {paymentId,version,transactionCount,loans:[{loanId,version}],previousPaymentId?}; mode=new|associate|correctExisting; max 20 unique versioned loan allocations with explicit principalMinor/interestMinor/feeMinor and expense/accrued treatment; exact sum; associate only links an exact existing composition; correctExisting atomically replaces the whole source and preserves roots for reversal; replacePayment explicitly identifies a duplicate manual payment and its current loan versions; chargeAllocations[{chargeId?,transactionId?,component,amountMinor}] required as exact cost evidence for configured charge contracts. accrued clears recorded/baseline remaining capacity; expense first records a selected planned charge. Existing credit bill association may carry unallocatedMinor; all shares plus unallocated equal actual total; never duplicate a source.

loans.source.returns: {source:{transactionIds,fingerprint,event},transactions,evidence}; select 1..60 current-user transactions; expands one imported event to all active members; signed complete transaction/event/update versions; no amount/date automatic match

loans.correct.returns: {paymentId,version,previousPaymentId,transactionCount,loans}; preserve previous reversed payment; check old/new loan versions, final cash and principal atomically; imported source total/account/time fixed

loans.reverse.returns: {paymentId,version,reversed,loans}; current versions for every allocated loan; reverse whole group or reject without partial changes

loans.payment.returns: {payment,repayment?,allocations,transactions,chargeAllocations,unallocatedMinor}; pending confirmed payments have empty allocations; max 20 loans / 60 transactions, current loan versions plus frozen confirmedLoanVersion

loans.payments.returns: {items,nextCursor}; pageSize 1..40, signed user/loan scope, includes reversal history

categoryHierarchy.selection: A transaction stores one categoryId; roots and children are both selectable. Uncategorized import remains allowed.
categoryHierarchy.identity: parentId is nullable and immutable after creation; parent must belong to the same trusted uid and kind. Active names are unique among siblings.
categoryHierarchy.archive: Archiving a root atomically archives active children; response retains root fields and adds categories[] with changed rows. Restoring a root does not restore children; restoring a child requires an active parent.
categoryHierarchy.directories: bootstrap, catalog, categories and import options include parentId. Paged import options also return parentName and search both parent and child names.
categoryHierarchy.transactions: category adds parentId, parentName and systemKey. categoryId filtering matches the selected category and its immediate children in the same read snapshot; existing revision-bound pagination remains mandatory.
categoryHierarchy.statistics: expenseCategories/incomeCategories roll up by root, retaining net refund accounting. children[] contains each child and an optional direct=true bucket named 未细分. Uncategorized stays a separate null-ID group. No amount is counted twice.
categoryHierarchy.presets: Bootstrap adds missing roots/children under the existing user lock; preserves custom names, archived rows and all IDs; same-name custom categories are not adopted. Revision advances only when rows are actually inserted.

rules.identity: identity is resolved only from trusted WeChat context; identity-shaped client fields are rejected recursively; bootstrap returns the current user uid for display and saved nickname for presentation only
rules.uid: one immutable 10-digit decimal string per user, first digit nonzero; displayed and copied unchanged; existing UUID ownership is migrated by 0011; other entity and request IDs remain UUIDs
rules.money: minor-unit decimal strings only; JavaScript floating point is forbidden
rules.time: occurredLocalAt plus JavaScript getTimezoneOffset() minutes; optional date and month filters use local date
rules.mutation: requestId is UUID; same key and request replays, same key with different request conflicts
rules.deletion: accounts and categories archive; manual transactions soft-delete; no physical business deletion
rules.refund: manual refunds must reference one active original expense; imported pending refunds credit one account without affecting income or expense statistics until linked
rules.cashBalance: a write may not create or deepen a negative cash balance; historical negative cash remains visible and only improving writes or an explicit balance correction are allowed

successEnvelope.data: action-specific public result; bootstrap includes uid and saved nickname; WeChat OpenID and identity digests are never returned
